notes.title: patch 1.35.2
Better Ultimate Spells and Welcome Gift!
notes.content: [h2]NEW[/h2][p][/p][p]+ Welcome gift for new players (old players will also receive);[/p][p]+ Dragon abilities are now displayed in the pause menu;[/p][p]+ A gray circle is shown on the ground while you fly, indicating your current position and making it easier to dodge skills.[/p][p][/p][h2]CHANGES[/h2][p][/p][p]+ Pisces' ability 'Dive' now increases damage and area based on the stamina spent instead of time spent while underwater;[/p][p]+ Tha advanced spell 'Nova' has been buffed: now also destroy projectiles and ice Boss shield;[/p][p]+ The 'Vampiric Power' card has been changed: now, instead of stealing life equal to a percentage of your damage dealt, you restore a fixed amount of life based on the number of stacks of the card;[/p][p]+ The cards 'Savagery', 'Focus', 'Strategy' and 'Apocalypse' have been removed from Common rarity, making them only obtainable from Uncommon and Rare rarities.[/p][p][/p][h2]BALANCING[/h2][p][/p][p]+ Scorpio Dragon has been [b]nerfed[/b];[/p][p]+ Taurus Dragon has been [b]buffed[/b] (5% armor dmg -> 8% armor dmg + 1% max HP dmg -> 3% max HP dmg);[/p][p]+ Savagery has been [b]nerfed[/b]: (+6 damage -> +5% damage);[/p][p]+ Apocalypse has been [b]buffed[/b]: (+6 damage -> +8% damage);[/p][p]+ Lightning Zone effect has been [b]nerfed[/b]: now when you are stunned you gain stun immunity for 1 second before you can be stunned again (preventing infinite stun);[/p][p]+ The ultimates 'Tornado', 'Meteors' and 'Discharge' have been [b]buffed[/b]: (Tornado now also attracts projectiles into its rotation, launching them away when finished. Meteors now leave damage-per-second areas on the ground at the impact location. Discharge now increases your movement speed while it lasts);[/p][p]+ The epic card 'God of Destruction' has been [b]buffed[/b]: reduces the cooldown of ultimates by 25 seconds -> 30 seconds[/p][p][/p][h2]FIXES[/h2][p][/p][p]+ Pisces ability stacking while pause (fixed);[/p][p]+ Gross Impact icon not showing (fixed); [/p][p]+ Harder Scales 20 stacks limit (removed);[/p][p]+ First wave with attributes cards instead of spells (fixed).[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Lightning Zone
notes.content: [h2]NEW[/h2][p][/p][p]+ Lightning Zone;[/p][p]+ Lightning Boss.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/5914e2083a7f476ece44ac6eaa5e34abc678c067.png"][/img][/p][h2]FIXES[/h2][p][/p][p]+ (Fixed) Anger Fairy shoot not dealing dmg to targets sometimes;[/p][p]+ (Fixed) Wind Intrisic and Aries Ability making bosses come with extremely high HP; [/p][p]+ (Fixed) Boss skill still deal dmg even when the effect desapears;[/p][p]+ (Fixed) Cards bug when getting all spells at max level.[/p][p][/p][h2]CHANGES[/h2][p][/p][p]+ Walking move speed increased;[/p][p]+ Lightning intrinsic: now needs 10 stacks to stun, but deals more dmg;[/p][p]+ Intrisic skills now have a different icon color and shape;[/p][p]+ Passive spells now have a limit of 3.[/p]

notes.title: patch 1.34.9
notes.content:
FIXES

+ Controller bug fixed.

BALANCING

+ Skeletal Dragon's ability has been buffed: now, it starts each wave with 50% HP. Above 50% HP, reduces healing received from 100% to 0% at 100% HP. Below 50% HP, increases healing received to from 100% to 200% at 0% HP.

notes.title: patch 1.34.8
notes.content:
CHANGES

+ Sorrow fairy now shows shield stacks.

FIXES

+ Sorrow fairy shield bug fixed;
+ Wizard's magic explosion fixed.

BALANCING

+ Sorrow fairy shield now blocks 2 attack instead of 3.

notes.title: Suporte para Controle!
notes.content: [h1]NEW[/h1][p][/p][p]+ Now playable with joysticks! Just plug in and enjoy. Keyboard or joystick controls are displayed in the "Settings" menu.[/p][p][/p][h2]FIXES[/h2][p][/p][p]+ The Sorrow Fairy's shield has been fixed;[/p][p]+ Wizards' magic explosion has been nerfed.[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Leaderboard and New Dragons
notes.content: [h1]NEW[/h1][p][/p][h3]+ Weekly Leaderboard[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/3a945a8652e25cc614f2f10f6df09405994182c3.png"][/img][/p][h3]+ New Dragon: [b]Capricorn[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/0fae9f240b23b1b86e505cbadd17f16dad089487.png"][/img][/p][h3]+ New Dragon: [b]Aquarius[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/0aa6d60e50cff96a39f07f24b6eb7adc146ffa44.png"][/img][/p][h3]+ New Dragon: [b]Pisces[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/888ffdff62675a901f0117b23c80660c99881d58.png"][/img][/p][h3]+ New Dragon: [b]Evans[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/d279af004f581ce0a04666e77b9ad3c6566b341d.png"][/img][/p][h1]CHANGES[/h1][p][/p][p]+ The camera now zooms out along the waves (max zoom reached at wave 36);[/p][p]+ The card 'Anger Fairy' is now an uncommon card and its damage increases with 'Strategy' and 'Apocalypse';[/p][p]+ Taurus Dragon's ability now increases damage with 'Strategy' instead of 'Focus'.[/p][p][/p][h1]BALANCE[/h1][p][/p][p]+ Taurus Dragon's ability now deals extra damage equivalent to 4% of target's max HP;[/p][p]+ Duck's ability now has a chance to double uncommon and rare cards.[/p]

notes.title: Save Your Run!
notes.content: [h1]NEW[/h1][p][/p][p]+ New Dragon: Sagittarius Dragon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/06a2f69592ea7c4d4b837e4da514374a4f5f4de3.png"][/img][/p][p]+ Save Run System: You can now save your run by clicking "quit" in the pause menu to continue later.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/e5d07a2630d53c52efb803a06cf935b81c9612e6.png"][/img][/p][p]+ Card Information: You can now view information about your card stacks in the pause menu by hovering over them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/dcc0e3798e525ea06303da407528eece28a1b946.png"][/img][/p][h1]CHANGES[/h1][p][/p][p]+ The "TAURUS" dragon has had its ability reworked: now, pressing 'J' allows you to dash toward the target, attacking it with a horn attack and gaining a temporary shield that blocks melee and projectile attacks. It can no longer obtain 'SWIFTNESS' cards, but its dash now extends much further and receives a 90% damage reduction while dashing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/8b4a557449ad536b6136a6871add9e39be77beb1.png"][/img][/p][p]+ The epic card "COLOSSUS" now also instantly grants +1600 max HP.[/p][p][/p][h1]BALANCE[/h1][p][/p][p]+ The burning of fire environment now deals increasing damage as the waves progress; [/p][p]+ Fire and Ice bosses' special attacks now reach the sky, making the battle more challenging, even if the player is flying;[/p][p]+ The 'SWIFTNESS' card has been nerfed: it now reduces the dash cooldown by 0.4 sec instead of 0.5.[/p]

notes.title: Basic Attacks Upgrade
notes.content: [h1]Changes[/h1][p][/p][p]+ New difficulty progression system: Enemies now start easier, not just weaker, and as waves progress, enemies become harder, not just stronger. This difficulty is reflected in aspects like casting speed, movement speed, accuracy, etc;[/p][p]+ The basic attack upgrade system has been improved: now, each level of the basic attack makes a much bigger difference:[/p][list][*][p]Ball: Significantly increases damage with each level[/p][/*][*][p]Beam: Increases size with each level[/p][/*][*][p]Missile: Launches 1 extra missile with each level[/p][/*][*][p]Blast: +10% range and +25% chance to launch an extra burst with each level[/p][/*][*][p]Rock: +100% explosion area with each level[/p][/*][/list][p]+ The epic card "Ravenous Blows" has been changed: now your basic attacks are cast in bursts of 2 instead of 1;[/p][p]+ Fire Intrinsic "Ignite" has been improved: now deals extra damage equivalent to 2% of target's max HP.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: patch 1.34.2
patch 1.34.1
New Systems
notes.content: [h1]Changes[/h1][p][/p][p]+ Leaderboard reseted;[/p][p]+ New spell system: now only 3 spells can be obtained (excluding the initial basic attack). The other two slots are reserved for ultimate spells;[/p][p]+ New basic attack system: now basic attacks ROTATE, casting one at a time, not all at once;[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/c588d7b59193d0261dd8c1e9294e11b683f3bd30.png"][/img][/p][p]+ New ultimate spell system: now ultimate spells can no longer be obtained from cards. To obtain them, you must raise a basic attack to level 3:[/p][list][*][p]Elemental Ball Lv 3 -> Elemental Meteors[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental Bolt Lv 3 -> Bring Element[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental Missile Lv 3 -> Corrupting Element[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental Chain Lv 3 -> Elemental Discharge[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental Blast Lv 3 -> Elemental Tornado[/p][/*][*][p]Fragmented Elemental Stone Lv 3 -> Raise Elemental Stones[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/3479085f2a0b1d9932c695887f2a29b5ad026c90.png"][/img][/p][p]+ Special effects for Cyber ​​Dragon and Duck Morph abilities.[/p][p][/p][h1]Buff and Nerfs[/h1][p][/p][p]+ Troll Riders' aim has been improved, and their Smash now deals fixed damage equal to 20% of your maximum health;[/p][p]+ All enemies have been nerfed (less damage and less HP) to match the new basic attack rotation system;[/p][p]+ Cybernetic Dragon has been nerfed: it now has a 60% chance to gain the extra card per wave;[/p][p]+ Close Combat has been nerfed: it now increases by 20% instead of 50%.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Cards and Changes
notes.content: [h1][b]NEW[/b][/h1][p]+ New Common, Uncommon and Rare Card: "FOCUS";[/p][p]+ New Epic Card by stacking 10 "STRATEGY";[/p][p]+ New Epic Card by stacking 4 "IMPOSING WINGS";[/p][h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1][p]+ The game has been [b]optimized[/b], reducing the amount of enemy particles;[/p][p]+ Changes to the in-game [b]interface[/b], with a more optimized and organized space;[/p][p]+ Spells icons with different colors to distinguish [b]basic[/b], [b]advanced[/b] and [b]ultimate[/b] spells;[/p][p]+ [b]Card stacks[/b] are now shown at the top of the screen during gameplay;[/p][p]+ [b]Passive spells[/b] are now shown at the bottom of the screen;[/p][p]+ [b]Other stacks[/b] are now shown in the right corner of the screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/c3db645bc08d1ffd06e9ad014f5dcf4d8316004b.png"][/img][/p][p]+ Now you descend much faster when pressing [b]SHIFT[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/f872414bad90a36fe6cd1ba5fa1655b482c75ea9.png"][/img][/p][p]+ The advanced spell "[b]Wave[/b]" (and all morphs: Fire Wave, Ice Wave, Dark Wave, Lightning Wave, Wind Wave, Earth Wave) has been completely changed to "[b]Vortex[/b]", which now deals damage per second for 5 seconds.[/p]

Executing enemies with [b]Lethal Sting[/b] gives you +3 damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/0f8cc6e5675d486b225c04c2c0f49d2e18b8c271.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1][list][*][p]In the [b]Dragons[/b] menu, you can now see better details of dragons, with a closer frontal view;[/p][/*][*][p]The double dash issue has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Up and Down!
notes.content: [h1]CARDS[/h1][p][/p][p]"EPIC" cards are now called "UNIQUE", to emphasize that they can only be obtained once.[/p][p]"LEGENDARY" cards are now called "EPIC".[/p][p]The epic card "HEART EATER" is now obtained by stacking 6 "VAMPIRIC POWER" instead of 8 "STRONG HEART".[/p][p]Two new cards have been [b]ADDED[/b] to the game:[/p][list][*][p][b](Uncommon) IMPOSING WINGS[/b][/p][list][*][p]EFFECT: Increases your ascent and descent speed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b](Epic) COLOSSUS[/b][/p][list][*][p]CONDITION: Stack 8 "STRONG HEARTS".[/p][/*][*][p]EFFECT: Upon landing, deals AOE damage based on your max HP and the max height reached during flight.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]CHANGES[/h1][p][/p][p]The falling system when running out of stamina has been changed:[/p][list][*][p]New animations for the character falling and landing;[/p][/*][*][p]The character now falls much faster, allowing the player to reach the ground faster and return to combat in time. This also greatly helps with the use of the COLOSSUS card.[/p][/*][/list][p]Enemy projectiles have been simplified in their visual effects, reducing visual clutter in waves with many projectiles.[/p]

notes.title: New Cards
notes.content: [h1]NEW CARDS[/h1][p][/p][h2]We bring 4 new legendary cards:[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]THICK LEATHER[/b][/p][list][*][p]CONDITION: Stack 12 "Harder Scales" (Armor);[/p][/*][*][p]EFFECT: 20% chance to block attacks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]LETHAL IMPACT[/b][/p][list][*][p]CONDITION: Stack 15 "Empowered Attack" (Critical Chance);[/p][/*][*][p]EFFECT: +100% Critical Damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]FATAL HEMORRHAGE[/b][/p][list][*][p]CONDITION: Stack 4 "Chronic Wounds" (Bleeding);[/p][/*][*][p]EFFECT: Enemies die instantly when health drops below 15%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]HEART EATER[/b][/p][list][*][p]CONDITION: Stack 8 "Strong Heart" (HP);[/p][/*][*][p]EFFECT: Gain +1 max HP for each enemy you eliminate.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/10b60fd75747da92c8f45a030e1bc6e96d68e439.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]CHANGES[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]The "Strong Heart" card now gives double health. The uncommon card gives +400 and the rare card gives +800;[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental dragons have been buffed and now start with the element's intrinsic passive at maximum level;[/p][/*][*][p]The Griffin Morph has also been buffed, now receiving +200 HP per wave;[/p][/*][*][p]The Duck Morph has been nerfed, receiving only double the amount of common cards;[/p][/*][*][p]The Gemini Dragon now starts with 2 random fairies;[/p][/*][*][p]The Fear Fairy has returned to being a rare card and can be stacked up to 4 times;[/p][/*][*][p]The Fear Fairy no longer gains stacks when taking damage. Now she only gains stacks per second, reducing the maximum stacks until explosion by 5 for each "Fear Fairy" card stacked;[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies have been nerfed and now increase in strength (damage and HP) only every 5 waves, not every 1 wave.[/p][/*][*][p]The intrinsic passive of fire (Ignite) has been nerfed, aiming to keep up with the significant increase in player health with the new adjustments.[/p][/*][/list]

"Swiftness" card now reduces the cooldown of dashes by 0.5 seconds (max of 4 cards, totaling a 2-second reduction).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/eff996d9a4bfb9a64bd995c0a016e10571106167.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Feature: Dashes!
notes.content: [h1]NEW: Dash![/h1][list][*][p]It is now possible to perform a DASH by pressing J![/p][/*][*][p]Dashes cost stamina.[/p][/*][/list][h1]New card[/h1][list][*][p]The uncommon card "SWIFTNESS" has been added, which reduces the stamina cost of dashing and increases the distance traveled when dashing.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1][list][*][p]Enemies have been nerfed (less HP and less damage), so that the player can have an easier start.[/p][/*][*][p]The burning effect of the fire environment has been nerfed in the first waves and buffed in more distant waves, aiming to keep up with the player's development.[/p][/*][*][p]The intrinsic passives of the WIND and EARTH elements have been nerfed:[/p][list][*][p]WIND: now has a limit of 100 stacks;[/p][/*][*][p]EARTH: now has a limit of 20 stacks per enemy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.31.4 Update
notes.content: + Fixed bug where you couldn't cast active skills while walking and casting auto attacks.

notes.title: Automatic Basic Attacks!
notes.content:
[h1]Automatic Basic Attacks[/h1]

+ Basic attacks are now cast automatically.

+ Multiple basic attacks can be cast at the same time.

+ Basic attacks provide a button relief for the player, allowing them to simply walk, fly, and cast active abilities when needed.

[h1]Boss Balancing[/h1]

+ Bosses have been adjusted and balanced to match the player's strength level, ensuring that the fight always lasts the same amount of time, regardless of the wave's strength.

notes.title: 1.31.1 Update
notes.content:
[h1]BALANCING[/h1]

+ The game has been completely rebalanced so that the player has a calmer start, while becoming more challenging in more distant waves.

+ The "SHORT TEMPER" card has been removed from the game for balance reasons.

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

+ The "FEAR FAIRY", "WALKING FORTRESS" and "TIME WARP" cards are now part of a new card rarity: Epic.

+ Epic Cards: Colored blue, they are rarer than "Rare" cards and can only be found once, each.

+ The "DANCING STONES" skill now deals much more damage when recast against enemies.

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

+ Some bugs have been fixed:
    - The recast button for the "DANCING STONES" skill has been fixed.
    - Exponential armor stack has been removed.

notes.title: 1.31.0 Update
notes.content:
The interface buttons and card sprites have been improved, bringing more visual comfort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534004/0ecd0a26559305782bc6cd5d7187a937ab0c96ba.png[/img]
